text: First Source has reported these discrepancies on my credit report illegally because when I chose to opt out from them reporting anything to third party companies, they did not comply and it states in US Code Title 15 Chapter 94 ( c ) Limits on reuse of information Except as otherwise provided in this subchapter, a nonaffiliated third party that receives from a financial institution nonpublic personal information under this section shall not, directly or through an affiliate of such receiving third party, disclose such information to any other person that is a nonaffiliated third party of both the financial institution and such receiving third party, unless such disclosure would be lawful if made directly to such other person by the financial institution. The company has reported inaccuracies to my credit report fraudulently. I requested a contract and have never received anything on the matter.
